title: Abomination
name: Bigby
description: The Abomination is half man, half eldritch beast, and keeps himself in chains because he cannot fully control the transformations. Between them he is a quiet, educated man, painfully polite and ashamed of the space he takes up. He has made his peace with dying, and asks only to be of some use before he does.
history: The Abomination was an endlessly curious scholar of alchemy and the stars. While hunting rare night-flora he was mauled by a beast, and the antidote he brewed for himself saved his life, but left something else living in him. Inquisitors found him days later, bloodied and crouched over a slaughtered cow, and declared him possessed. His terror under the torturer set to drive it out finally woke the beast. He came to in the catacombs beneath the tower with little memory of what he had done, and put his own chains back on.
summary: A gentle, ashamed scholar with a beast beneath his skin, who keeps himself in chains so it cannot hurt anyone.

appearance.hairStyle: Long on one side, shaved on the other
appearance.features: A brand burned into his forehead/A horned, fanged beast's head

clothing.head: None
clothing.body: Ragged green cloak, with chains and padlocks wrapped around his torso
clothing.accessories: Iron manacles, a padlock at his belt

notes: Soft-spoken and meek, and caught off guard by any kindness shown to him
Once he grows comfortable in someone's company, which takes time, the scholar in him resurfaces, reaching for alchemy, the classics and the stars
Lapses into Ostvenger when strained or hungry
Has a crippling dread of water, and will not bathe
Starves himself, believing hunger keeps the beast weaker
